name: Scratch Calculator
description: Line-by-line expression scratchpad: arithmetic and powers, variable assignment, previous-result reference and common length/mass/time units. A failing line does not stop later lines.

evaluate.angleMode: Angle mode for trigonometry: deg (default) or rad

statistics.summary: Summarize multi-line numbers (expressions and units allowed): count, sum, mean, median, variance and standard deviation
statistics.input: One number or expression per line

input.label: Expressions
input.placeholder:
One expression per line, e.g.
x = 6
x * 7
1m + 10cm

results.title: Results
results.empty: Enter expressions on the left and results appear here line by line

errors.eval.dimension_mismatch: Units of different dimensions cannot be added or subtracted
errors.eval.not_finite: Result is not a finite number
errors.eval.reserved_name: Cannot assign to a built-in constant or function: {{name}}
errors.eval.expected_lparen: Missing opening parenthesis in function call
errors.eval.missing_args: At least one argument is required

syntax: Arithmetic and powers: + - * / ^, parentheses change precedence
Variables: x = 6 then reference x; prev is the last expression line's result
Units: 1km + 10cm, 2kg, 3min; addition and subtraction require the same dimension
Lines starting with # are comments; blank lines are skipped; a failing line does not stop later lines
Functions: sin cos tan asin acos atan sqrt cbrt ln log10 log2 exp abs round floor ceil fact deg rad min max; constants: pi tau e phi
